cards.card_text: The LORD tells him Israel has sinned and transgressed His covenant.
cards.verse_text: Israel has sinned; they have transgressed My covenant that I commanded them, and they have taken some of what was devoted to destruction.
cards.snippet: Israel has sinned; they have transgressed My covenant that I commanded them, and they have taken some of…

cards.card_text: He transgressed the covenant of the LORD He ran away from the battle at Ai He refused to march around Jericho
cards.verse_text: The one who is caught with the things devoted to destruction must be burned, along with all that belongs to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of the LORD and committed an outrage in Israel.’”
cards.snippet: …be burned, along with all that belongs to him, because he has transgressed the covenant of the LORD and committed an outrage in Israel.’”

cards.card_text: Now Saul finally says it: “I have sinned; I have transgressed the LORD’s commandment and your instructions…” Took him a while, but he gets there.
cards.verse_text: Then Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; I have transgressed the LORD’s commandment and your instructions, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
cards.snippet: Then Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; I have transgressed the LORD’s commandment and your instructions, because I feared the people and…

cards.card_text: Elihu says God tells them their deeds, and how arrogantly they've transgressed.
cards.verse_text: And if men are bound with chains, caught in cords of affliction, then He tells them their deeds and how arrogantly they have transgressed.
cards.snippet: …affliction, then He tells them their deeds and how arrogantly they have transgressed.

cards.card_text: They have transgressed the laws and overstepped the decrees.
cards.verse_text: The earth is defiled by its people; they have transgressed the laws; they have overstepped the decrees and broken the everlasting covenant.
cards.snippet: The earth is defiled by its people; they have transgressed the laws; they have overstepped the decrees and broken the everlasting covenant.

cards.card_text: God will purge out the ones who rebel and transgress against Him.
cards.verse_text: And I will purge you of those who rebel and transgress against Me.
cards.snippet: And I will purge you of those who rebel and transgress against Me.

cards.card_text: Like Adam, they have transgressed the covenant, and there they were unfaithful to God.
cards.verse_text: But they, like Adam, have transgressed the covenant; there they were unfaithful to Me.
cards.snippet: But they, like Adam, have transgressed the covenant; there they were unfaithful to Me.

cards.card_text: Transgress and rebel even more Tear down every altar there Rest and celebrate together
cards.verse_text: “Go to Bethel and transgress; rebel even more at Gilgal!
cards.snippet: “Go to Bethel and transgress; rebel even more at Gilgal!
